title: Bayern and Manchester City close on the Women's Champions League top four
summary: Bayern München won 2-1 at Paris Saint-Germain and Manchester City beat Inter 4-1 as the Women's Champions League league phase reached matchday four on 10 November. Real Madrid and Roma claimed their first wins of the phase, 3-0 over Paris FC and 2-1 against Servette, while Chelsea were held 0-0 at Häcken despite 27 attempts. Bayern moved second on eight points behind Barcelona; Chelsea also have eight, with Paris Saint-Germain on five.
